prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her late 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real pores, real living eyes, 150 drop dangles piercings set with rubies in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a necklace. Wearing a minimal cross-wrap string micro bikini made entirely of matte black stretch lycra: a cross-wrap top made of two narrow flat matte black stretch lycra bands, each only two fingers wide, that start at the sides of her ribs, rise diagonally across each breast, cross in an X at the center of her chest and tie behind her neck, and a low-rise string micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque matte black stretch lycra triangle on thin side strings tied at her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her pregnant belly fully bare above it. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme matte black stretch lycra extreme platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
